scope: Progreso imagery selection and the 2015 error

2015_inventory.Chuburna_and_Chelem: No verified 2015 HD acquisition in their frozen locality calendars. A dated reference is retained.

fixed: A known capture date is not marked as a failed metadata query merely because it differs from the analysis year or another edition lookup failed.
The UI distinguishes missing local-year imagery from partial municipal-year coverage and from a genuinely failed selected-date lookup.
The renderer uses a conservative z17 ceiling until that edition has its own confirmed native ceiling. A warm old edition cannot borrow the selected newer edition's higher ceiling.

validation.root_browser_observation_Chuburna_2015: The 2011 photograph retained its real date, the missing 2015 HD notice appeared, and no image error was visible.
validation.live_availability_probe: Edition 18820 at the municipal center returned valid zero at z20 and z19. Lower probes encountered timeout/DNS failures; these are recorded as transport failures, not absence evidence.
